meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; start there.
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't shown me a single thing, and if Owen sits a rewrite now, that's an admission he has nothing to admit. On what basis did you enter that zero?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
"Generous." I'm not most parents, and Owen didn't do anything that needs your generosity. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until I see what that zero was based on.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and the basis for that decision. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see what it was based on. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record (procedure 4.4), and your offer was close to that, but she never heard any evidence, so she had no reason to accept it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her anything she could check.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before any evidence and then pushed her to take it, which to her made accepting look like an admission that Owen did something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side never brought up any times or dates, so you came nowhere near that night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show one dated, checkable piece of Owen's own work before you mention a rewrite at all.
